title: I’m building a tool to help indie game devs
author: 22mx3mcopperpipe
selftext:
Hi Reddit! 👋  
I’ve been making a website called **BINX Forge** (named after my cat Binx 🐈‍⬛) to help us all find assets, tools and ways to make our games better!  
One of the main features is **Build a Game** — tell it what you want to make, mix different genres/themes/features, and it helps find **free and paid assets, code, animations, VFX and tools** that could help you build it.  
Already making a game? Tell Forge what needs improving and it’ll help find things that could make it better.  
It can then put everything into a prompt ready to copy into the AI you’re building with.  
It’s still **very early in development** with a lot more coming, but I wanted to share what I’ve been working on!  
**Think it. Forge it. Play it. 🔨**  
[https://binxforge.com](https://binxforge.com/)  
 Honest feed back to help me improve will be grateful and appreciated it many thanks :))
